claims.text: Age-appropriate cancer screening (eg, colonoscopy, mammography) if not already done.
claims.quote: Age-appropriate cancer screening (eg, colonoscopy, mammography) is indicated if not previously performed.

claims.text: One suggested panel without focal findings: chest x-ray, urinalysis, CBC with differential, ESR or CRP, HIV test, chemistries (electrolytes, calcium, liver and kidney tests) and TSH.
claims.quote: One suggested approach is to do the following tests: Chest radiograph Urinalysis Complete blood count (CBC) with differential count Erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) or C-reactive protein (CRP) HIV testing Serum chemistries (serum electrolytes, calcium, hepatic and renal function tests) Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) level

claims.text: If all results are normal, extensive further testing (CT, MRI) is not recommended.
claims.quote: If all test results are normal and clinical findings are otherwise normal, extensive further testing (eg, CT, MRI) is not recommended.

claims.text: Follow up in about 1 month with a weight check.
claims.quote: have a follow-up evaluation in approximately 1 month that includes a weight measurement

claims.text: If weight loss continues with otherwise normal findings, consider CT or MRI.
claims.quote: If weight loss continues and all other findings remain normal, further testing (eg, CT, MRI) should be considered.
